decks.notes: This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while developing a strong board presence. Utilizing disruptive creatures like Collector Ouphe and Deathrite Shaman, along with powerful spells like Force of Will and Assassin's Trophy, the deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent. The inclusion of efficient threats like Oko, Thief of Crowns and Tarmogoyf allows the deck to apply pressure and close out games quickly. By combining disruption, card advantage, and aggressive threats, this deck aims to dominate the early and mid-game to secure victory.

The core mechanic of this deck is to quickly dig through your library, set up a winning combination of cards with Doomsday, and then use a variety of counterspells and hand disruption to protect your victory condition. By combining card draw, tutors, and powerful spells like Ancestral Recall and Time Walk, you can set up a winning Thassa's Oracle or Demonic Tutor play and secure the win before your opponent can respond. The deck is designed to be fast, efficient, and deadly in a Vintage 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on utilizing Bazaar of Baghdad to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures like Bloodghast, Hogaak, and Vengevine, enabling powerful aggro plays. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Collector Ouphe and Force of Vigor to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, the deck leverages the versatility of Once Upon a Time to quickly assemble its game plan. The inclusion of cards like Hollow One and Deathrite Shaman further reinforces the aggressive nature of the deck, allowing for fast and explosive starts.

The deck is focused on creating a lock and controlling the game by utilizing powerful countermagic and card advantage. It includes powerful cards like Karn, Scion of Urza, Narset, Parter of Veils, and Hullbreacher to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes key combo pieces such as Time Vault and Voltaic Key along with powerful draw spells like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time. By utilizing a mix of disruption, card advantage, and combo potential, the deck aims to control the game and secure a win through incremental advantage.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with creatures to take advantage of graveyard interactions like Vengevine and Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis. Utilizing cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Stitcher's Supplier, the deck can quickly deploy threats like Hollow One and Bloodghast. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive elements like Force of Vigor to answer opposing threats. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive game plan while also providing access to a variety of colors for casting spells like Once Upon a Time and Deathrite Shaman.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly power out aggressive creatures like Basking Rootwalla, Blazing Rootwalla, and Vengevine using cards like Hollow One and Master of Death. The deck also focuses on disrupting the opponent with counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation, as well as removal spells like Force of Vigor and Mindbreak Trap. The deck also utilizes graveyard recursion with cards like Squee, Goblin Nabob and Noxious Revival. The land base includes powerful utility lands like Bazaar of Baghdad and Wasteland to further disrupt the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the mechanic of "Dredge" to quickly fill the graveyard with cards like Golgari Grave-Troll and Stinkweed Imp, allowing for explosive plays using cards like Bridge from Below and Prized Amalgam. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and consistent combo strategy, using cards like Cabal Therapy and Creeping Chill to disrupt the opponent's game plan while staying ahead in the resource game with cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Noxious Revival. The deck also includes interaction and protection with Force of Will and Force of Negation.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful blue draw spells and countermagic while also utilizing red burn spells for aggression. The key strategy is to efficiently control the opponent's threats with counterspells and removal while deploying fast threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent to pressure the opponent's life total. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying consistent pressure to win quickly. The combination of card advantage, disruption, and aggression makes it a versatile and strong deck in Vintage 1 vs 1 gameplay.

The deck focuses on quickly putting pressure on the opponent using aggressive creatures like Basking Rootwalla, Blazing Rootwalla, and Hollow One, while also utilizing graveyard synergies with cards like Master of Death and Vengevine. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with a high number of free counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation, as well as removal like Force of Vigor. The deck also has ways to manipulate the graveyard with Noxious Revival and Bazaar of Baghdad, allowing for explosive starts and efficient plays.

The deck focuses on using powerful draw and search cards to quickly assemble the Underworld Breach combo, which allows the player to continuously cast spells from their graveyard. The deck includes disruption spells like Flusterstorm and Force of Will to protect the combo, along with efficient mana acceleration in the form of Moxen and Mana Crypt. Additionally, the deck includes a few key win conditions like Brain Freeze to mill the opponent's library or Bolas's Citadel for explosive card advantage. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a quick and efficient combo finish.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing powerful spells and disruptive creatures to prevent the opponent from executing their game plan. This includes countermagic like Force of Will and Flusterstorm, along with versatile cards like Demonic Tutor and Vampiric Tutor to search for key combo pieces. The deck also features efficient mana acceleration with the help of Moxen and powerful card advantage engines like Narset, Parter of Veils and Hullbreacher. By carefully managing resources and disrupting the opponent's strategy, this Grixis Control deck aims to outmaneuver and outlast its opponents in Vintage 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using counterspells and disruptive spells while also utilizing Oath of Druids as a powerful combo piece. The goal is to find and cast Oath of Druids to put a big creature like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn into play, giving the player a huge advantage. The deck also includes cards like Oko, Thief of Crowns and Karn, the Great Creator to further disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the deck aims to control the game tempo and win through powerful creatures and disruptive spells.

This deck is focused on assembling and executing the Doomsday combo, utilizing powerful card selection and disruption to find and protect the combo pieces. The key strategy involves using cards like Dark Ritual and Force of Will to set up a winning play with Doomsday and Thassa's Oracle. The deck also includes various tutors and cantrips to dig for combo pieces quickly, while also including disruption like Daze and Flusterstorm to protect the combo. This deck aims to win the game in a quick and efficient manner, with a strong emphasis on careful planning and sequencing.

The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game in a single explosive turn, while also having backup plans and protection against opposing strategies. It prioritizes efficiency and consistency in executing its game plan, aiming to disrupt the opponent's game plan while advancing towards its own win condition.
